newsitem.title: USA: CME lumber down near limit on fund selling, cash.
newsitem.headline: CME lumber down near limit on fund selling, cash.

text.p: CME lumber futures fell in late trading, after early short-covering support, as a lack of followthrough buying and persistent fund selling pressured futures along with weak cash, traders said.

The near $10-limit loss followed Tuesday's limit down close as cash lumber remained under pressure from slack demand and overproduction. Random lengths quoted cash spruce at $3.62, off $2.00 per tbf from last Friday.
Cargill Investor Services was the main seller in July, traders added. At 1301 CDT, July traded as much as $9.90 lower and stood at $363.70, off $9.80.
